### 4. What caused this bug?

* We should not use `/tmp` directly, we should use `os.TempDir()`
* When we created the `/tmp/tidb` directory, the code used was `os.MkdirAll(tempDir, 0755)`. This directory can only be accessed by the creator and root
  * Maybe we need to use `0777` to create `/tmp/tidb` and then use `0755` to create the remaining directories.
  * I think a more reasonable solution is to use `/<os.TempDir()>/<os.Getuid()>_tidb` as a prefix. TiKV used this [solution](https://github.com/tikv/tikv/pull/7470) when resolving similar [issue](https://github.com/tikv/tikv/issues/7462).
* One used subdirectory is `/tmp/tidb/<Base64(Port_StatusPort)>`, this directory is not unique. Different tidb can listen to addresses on the same port but different hostnames(like 127.0.0.1:4000/10080 and 172.16.5.1:4000/10080).
  * Since StatusHttp does not allow repeated listening, we can use `/<os.TempDir()>/<os.Getuid()>_tidb/<AdvertiseAddress_StatusPort>`
  * We can also use `ioutil.TempDir("", "oom-use-tmp-storage")` directly

The related default config is `path` (mockkv) and `oom-use-tmp-storage`(#15203).

That's wried, the root cause is TiDB storage path, whose default value is **"/tmp/tidb"**, is occupied by a previously started `tidb-server`.

In order to successfully start another tidb-server, we should modify TiDB storage path to another value that is not used by another running tidb-server. This is a feature by design.

But even when I changed the TiDB storage path to another value, I still get the error:

> The current temporary storage dir(/tmp/tidb/NDAwMC8xMDA4MA==/tmp-storage) has been occupied by another instance, check tmp-storage-path config and make sure they are different.%

@SunRunAway PTAL

It looks like the fix doesn't resolve this issue entirely. The second user could still get error like `["new store with retry failed"] [error="open /tmp/tidb/LOCK: permission denied"]` since the fix never changed the store path. It's also a conflict. @zz-jason Should we reopen this PR or have a new one?
That's the LOCK created by MockDriver(leveldb). Any suggestion on how to resolve this issue? @zz-jason @SunRunAway

> It looks like the fix doesn't resolve this issue entirely. The second user could still get error like `["new store with retry failed"] [error="open /tmp/tidb/LOCK: permission denied"]` since the fix never changed the store path. It's also a conflict. @zz-jason Should we reopen this PR or have a new one?

I don't think it's an issue because `/tmp/tidb/` is the `mocktikv`'s storage path and even if different OS users start tidb-server, the storage path should keep the same as the configuration file indicates.
Make sense. And the second user should specify another path to start a new tidb-server.
